definition: Went from one place to another, typically over a distance.
exampleSentence: Last summer we travelled across southern Italy.

definition: Went to see someone or a place.
exampleSentence: They visited three historical museums in Prague.
She bought some lovely souvenirs for her friends.

definition: Intercepted and held something moving, or boarded transport.
exampleSentence: We caught the express train just before departure.
The plane arrived twenty minutes ahead of schedule.

definition: Engaged in an activity for enjoyment.
exampleSentence: We played football after school yesterday.

definition: Looked at attentively over a period of time.
exampleSentence: They watched an exciting documentary last night.

definition: Marked letters or characters on a surface.
exampleSentence: She wrote an email to her manager.

definition: Moved from one place to another.
exampleSentence: He went to Paris by train last weekend.
We saw our old school friends at the cafe.
